message.content: Based on the information provided in the data tables, Wolfgang Schulz sent a message wishing Li Hua a happy Lunar New Year on January 19th, 2026, specifically mentioning that they would catch up soon. There is no mention of Wolfgang Schulz sending a message to Li Hua beforehand to inform her that she had prepared all the food for the Lunar New Year celebration. Therefore, we cannot confirm that Wolfgang Schulz sent a message to Li Hua with such a statement. Li Hua's message to Wolfgang Schulz does not indicate that she had prepared all the food in advance.
